title: Write a proposal
description: Advanced writing for professional proposals and formal communication.

items.prompt: Write an opening paragraph for a business proposal (5–7 sentences).
items.promptIt: Scrivi un paragrafo introduttivo per una proposta commerciale (5–7 frasi).

items.prompt: Rewrite one informal sentence in formal register.
items.promptIt: Riscrivi una frase informale in registro formale.
hints: Yeah, I think so → I would respectfully suggest...
